acceptanceCriteria: TestGoTestRunsUnresolvedAfterResolvedFailure fails on the previous goTest and passes with the fix: a resolved batch exiting 3 still runs and records the unresolved packages, and the step exits 3.
docs/specs/gate-ledger-v0.md GL-V0-004 states that a failing resolved batch does not stop the unresolved packages.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, tools/gate-ledger at origin/main b7b21205, hosted macos-15 Release gates run 37358656556 (1.0.0-rc.2 candidate 0ae3f88d), 2026-10-05. goTest returned the resolved batch's non-zero status before running the unresolved packages, so the log shows PARTITION 129 resolved / 184 unresolved, 206 ok, one FAIL (internal/tasks/service timeout) and no RUN go-test-unresolved line. The next candidate then failed on cem/verify, localcompletion and tasks/store, which the first run never executed. Expected (GL-V0-004): ledger/go-test runs every package go test ./... would, so one run reports every failing package. Actual: a failing resolved batch hides every unresolved failure. Fix: run the unresolved packages after a failed resolved batch (unless it was killed by a signal) and exit with the resolved batch's status.
title: gate-ledger go-test skips the unresolved packages when the resolved batch fails
